## Overview

Manage Omni Skills (list, install, test, remove), plugins (create, configure), and persistent memory (search, add, clear) from the CLI.

## Quick install

```bash
npm install -g aera-router   # or: npx aera-router
aera-router --version
```

## Subcommands

**Example:**

```bash
aera-router memory
```
